_about: What's new in each ZEHEN version. Shown inside the app (Settings > Software Update, and after an update) and copied into the update feed by scripts/release/publish.js so the 'update available' card can show it before downloading. Newest first. Benefits only, plain words, no internal mechanics.

releases.title: Each computer keeps its own printer
highlights: Main and client computers now keep separate printers for invoices, receipts and vouchers. Changing one computer no longer changes another.
Choose your printer once in Print Templates on each computer after updating, or leave it blank to use that computer’s system default.
The print-without-asking choice is also saved per computer. Invoice layouts stay shared.

releases.title: Parcel labels print right
highlights: Parcel labels now print straight to your label printer at the full 100 x 100 mm size, edge to edge, without the print window.
Labels print darker: small text like the sender and address is bolder. If it is still faint, choose Heavy darkness.
Choose the label printer, darkness and print a test label in Settings, Parcel Labels. Each computer keeps its own printer.

releases.title: Faster scanning, clearer customer
highlights: New repeat-scan choice: merge back-to-back scans. Scanning the same item again straight away adds to its quantity, and if it comes up again after other items it gets its own line, so the bill keeps the order you scanned in. Choose it in Settings, Sales Bill.

The customer on the sale bill now shows what they owe and whether credit is fine in one coloured tag, green when all is well and red when credit is blocked or over the limit, with their city and mobile beside it.
Long customer names show in full on the sale bill again.
The sidebar icons now have colours, and each area wears the same colour and icon in the sidebar and in Settings.

releases.title: Settings made simple, and parcel labels
highlights: Settings is arranged by the job you are doing: Sales Bill, Purchase Bill, Stock, Printing, Staff and Data. Every page has the same clean layout.
Search in Settings finds the exact setting, like negative stock or bill prefix, and takes you straight to it.
Print Templates is redesigned. Pick a style from live previews of your own bill and see the page exactly as it will print.
Print 10 x 10 cm parcel labels from the sale bill, for the customer on the bill or anyone you type in. Choose from six designs in Settings, Parcel Labels.
Choose whether your shop's name and address print on parcel labels, and hide the parcel button if you do not use it.

releases.title: Name and article together
highlights: Type a product name with its article number, like babla 1234, and search finds that exact design. Works in any order, and with /n for article-only search.
A space typed before or after the article number no longer hides the results.

releases.title: Find articles faster
highlights: Search by article number only: type /n and the number, and barcodes that happen to contain the same digits no longer get in the way. /b does the same for barcodes.
Typing a shortcut like /p now turns straight into a clean filter tag. Click the shortcuts at the bottom to switch filters, and press Backspace to remove one.
When one design comes in several sizes, search shows the stock of each size and the total at the bottom.
Stock Movement can show all sizes of an article together in one list when you want it, with the size marked on every entry.

releases.title: Barcode labels for big bills
highlights: Printing labels for a large purchase bill works every time, no matter how many labels you print at once.
Pick the rows to print by serial number: type 1-20, 36-50 or 50, 51, 52, 63 and those rows are selected for you.
Each row now shows its serial number, in a compact grid that matches the purchase bill.
A cleaner label window with the label count, items and pieces always in view, and a Print button that says exactly how many labels it will print.

releases.title: Clearer product search on bills
highlights: Searching a product on a sale or purchase bill shows its category, size and stock in neat columns, so you pick the right one.
A product name used in two categories now shows as two choices, and the Category box fills in when you pick.
The row you are on with the arrow keys is clearly highlighted in every dropdown.
The letters you typed are marked in each name, every category has its own colour dot, and the sale Size list uses the same tidy table.

releases.title: See how each supplier's products sell
highlights: Product Sales Detail has a new Bought from filter: pick a supplier to see the sales of the products you bought from them.
Combine it with customer, category, product and dates; totals, print and export follow the filter.

releases.title: A faster, clearer purchase bill
highlights: Purchase bills show the Category of every line, like sale bills.
The entry row fits every screen, from laptops to large monitors, and text in the items list lines up neatly.
A supplier bill number you already entered is flagged as Duplicate, so the same bill is not entered twice.
For products from your list at their usual rate, Enter on Rate adds the line straight away.
Lines without a sale price or MRP are highlighted so nothing is missed.

releases.title: Your bills are never lost
highlights: An unfinished bill now saves itself as you type. If ZEHEN closes, the PC shuts down or the power goes, open Sales or Purchase and continue the bill where you left off.
ZEHEN keeps you signed in while it is open, so you are never signed out in the middle of a bill.
If you open ZEHEN while an update is still installing, it waits and opens the new version by itself instead of getting stuck.
Opening ZEHEN twice by mistake no longer starts two copies.

releases.title: Staff Statement in Reports
highlights: Staff Statement now looks and works exactly like your Customer and Supplier statements, with voucher numbers from your books.
Find it in Reports or search, or press Enter on any staff member in Payroll.
Choose columns, print, or export to PDF and Excel the same way as other statements.

releases.title: Staff statements
highlights: Staff Statement: salary earned, salary paid, advances and money given for any staff member, laid out like your customer and supplier statements.
Pick This FY, Last FY, This Quarter, This Month or any dates, with the opening balance carried over.
Print it or export it to PDF or Excel.
Open it with Enter on any staff member in Payroll, and pay or give money straight from it.

releases.title: Barcode labels fix
highlights: When a bill has the same barcode on several lines, each line can now be ticked and given its own label text and count when printing labels.

releases.title: Quicker payroll entry, and profit on every purchase bill
highlights: Payroll is a clean staff list with one entry line: choose a person, type the amount, press Enter.
Pay, give an advance or set a salary without opening a single window, and pay several selected staff at once.
Purchase bills show the profit and profit % for the whole bill as you enter it.
Fix a margin once and every new item on the bill gets it. Products from your list keep their own price.

releases.title: Payroll on one screen, and a clearer update experience
highlights: Payroll opens on one screen: who is owed what, and Pay everyone in two clicks.
Give money to any staff member in seconds. It comes off their next salary automatically.
Set a new person's salary right in the list, including their own salary date.
Software updates now show what's new first and download only when you choose.

releases.title: Staff accounts, staff profiles and safer salary books
highlights: Pay staff on their own cycle, like the 15th to the 14th, and settle any dates.
Staff profiles with photo, Aadhaar, PAN and emergency contact.
Staff photos across attendance and payroll.
Salary entries now respect your financial-year locks and back-dating rules.

releases.title: Payroll
highlights: Salaries worked out from attendance: absences, leave, holidays and overtime.
PF, ESI and Professional Tax for businesses that need them.
Advances recovered from salary automatically.
Printable payslips, and staff can see theirs on their phone.

releases.title: A clearer attendance register
highlights: Attendance register redesigned: who is in, who is late, and a live activity feed.
A month view where absences stand out at a glance.

releases.title: Staff app and bulk attendance
highlights: The staff check-in app works like a proper app, with your shop's name and logo.
Mark attendance and leave for many days at once.

releases.title: New sign-in and your preferences everywhere
highlights: A new sign-in screen.
Your preferences follow your login to any computer.
New reports: party lapse and top parties.

releases.title: Automatic updates and staff attendance
highlights: ZEHEN keeps itself up to date, and never interrupts your work.
Staff check in from their own phones. No attendance machine needed.
